scripts.dev: npm run dev -w @ai-news/api & npm run dev -w @ai-news/web
scripts.build: npm run build -w @ai-news/shared && npm run build -w @ai-news/api && npm run build -w @ai-news/web
scripts.test: npm run test -w @ai-news/web && npm run test -w @ai-news/shared
scripts.test:api: npm run build -w @ai-news/shared && npm run build -w @ai-news/api && npm run test -w @ai-news/api
scripts.test:smoke: npm run test:api && npm run test:e2e
scripts.start: npm run start -w @ai-news/api & npm run start -w @ai-news/web
